svg.aria-label: Lomuto partition of 3 7 1 9 4 8 6 2 5 around the last element, 5, rows 1 to 6 of 10. Green: keys smaller than the pivot, a[lo..i]; blue: keys scanned and not smaller; amber: the pivot; the ringed cell is a[j]. pivot = a[8] = 5: [3 7 1 9 4 8 6 2 5] (i = lo − 1 = −1:; the "< pivot" region is empty). j = 0 3 < 5: take: [3 7 1 9 4 8 6 2 5] (i at 0, j at 0) (i = 0: a no-op swap). j = 1 7 < 5? no: [3 7 1 9 4 8 6 2 5] (i at 0, j at 1) (skip). j = 2 1 < 5: take: [3 1 7 9 4 8 6 2 5] (i at 1, j at 2) (i = 1: swap a[1] and a[2]). j = 3 9 < 5? no: [3 1 7 9 4 8 6 2 5] (i at 1, j at 3) (skip). j = 4 4 < 5: take: [3 1 4 9 7 8 6 2 5] (i at 2, j at 4) (i = 2: swap a[2] and a[4]).
